title: Daily average per device 1
task: Set result to a Series of daily mean value for device 1 (set ts as index, resample 'D'), rounded to 3 decimals, sorted by day.

title: Hourly-of-day profile
context: Average by hour across all days for device 1.
task: Set result to a Series of mean value per hour-of-day (0-23) for device 1, rounded to 3 decimals, sorted by hour.

title: Average value per kind
task: Set result to a Series of mean value per device kind, rounded to 3 decimals.

title: Out-of-range readings
context: Flag readings outside the per-kind thresholds.
task: Set result to the number of readings whose value is below the low or above the high threshold for the device's kind (an int; ignore missing values).
answer:
m = readings.dropna(subset=['value']).merge(devices, on='device_id').merge(thresholds, on='kind')
result = int(((m['value'] < m['low']) | (m['value'] > m['high'])).sum())

title: Breaches per device
task: Set result to a Series of the number of out-of-range readings per device_id (only devices with at least one breach), sorted descending.
hint: merge, compute breach mask, groupby device_id sum.
answer:
m = readings.dropna(subset=['value']).merge(devices, on='device_id').merge(thresholds, on='kind')
m['breach'] = (m['value'] < m['low']) | (m['value'] > m['high'])
b = m.groupby('device_id')['breach'].sum()
result = b[b > 0].sort_values(ascending=False)

title: Forward-fill missing values
context: Carry the last good reading per device.
task: Set result to readings for device 1 (sorted by ts) with value forward-filled; keep reading_id, ts, value.
answer:
d = readings[readings['device_id'] == 1].sort_values('ts').copy()
d['value'] = d['value'].ffill()
result = d[['reading_id', 'ts', 'value']].reset_index(drop=True)

title: Interpolate gaps
task: Set result to the number of previously-missing values in device 1's series that become non-null after linear interpolation (an int).
hint: before/after isna counts on the interpolated series.
answer:
d = readings[readings['device_id'] == 1].sort_values('ts')
before = d['value'].isna().sum()
after = d['value'].interpolate().isna().sum()
result = int(before - after)

title: Readings per hour bucket
context: Volume by hour of day, all devices.
task: Set result to a Series of reading counts per hour-of-day (0-23), sorted by hour.

title: Battery drain per device
task: Set result to a Series of battery drop (first battery − last battery, by ts order) per device_id, rounded to 1 decimal.
answer:
d = readings.sort_values('ts')
first = d.groupby('device_id')['battery'].first()
last = d.groupby('device_id')['battery'].last()
result = (first - last).round(1)

title: Value by device and day
task: Set result to a pivot_table: index device_id, columns day (ts normalized), values mean value, rounded to 2 decimals (leave NaN for gaps).
hint: add day column, pivot_table aggfunc mean.
answer:
r = readings.copy()
r['day'] = r['ts'].dt.normalize()
result = r.pivot_table(index='device_id', columns='day', values='value', aggfunc='mean').round(2)

title: Devices with no readings
task: Set result to a Series of device name for devices with no rows in readings.

title: Value band
task: Set result to a Series of reading counts per value band using pd.cut on value with bins [-100,0,20,40,200] and labels ['neg','low','mid','high'].
answer:
b = pd.cut(readings['value'], bins=[-100, 0, 20, 40, 200], labels=['neg', 'low', 'mid', 'high'])
result = b.value_counts().sort_index()

title: Weekend readings
task: Set result to the number of readings taken on Saturday or Sunday (an int).

title: Value range per device
task: Set result to a Series of value range (max − min) per device_id, rounded to 3 decimals, sorted descending.
hint: groupby agg max and min, subtract.

title: Readings per site
task: Set result to a Series of reading counts per site, sorted descending.

title: Coverage gaps
context: Expected hourly readings vs actual for device 1.
task: Set result to the number of missing hourly slots for device 1 = (total hours in its range) − (rows present), an int. Use (max ts − min ts)/1h + 1 as expected.
hint: compute expected hours from the range.
answer:
d = readings[readings['device_id'] == 1]
expected = int((d['ts'].max() - d['ts'].min()).total_seconds() // 3600) + 1
result = int(expected - len(d))

title: Noisiest device
task: Set result to the device_id with the highest standard deviation of value (an int).

title: Battery percent bucket
task: Set result to a Series of counts per battery tier using pd.cut on battery with bins [0,20,50,80,100] and labels ['critical','low','ok','full'].
answer:
b = pd.cut(readings['battery'], bins=[0, 20, 50, 80, 100], labels=['critical', 'low', 'ok', 'full'])
result = b.value_counts().sort_index()

title: Devices with maintenance
task: Set result to the number of distinct device_id values that appear in maintenance (an int).

title: Battery increases
context: Battery should only fall between consecutive readings (except after a swap).
task: Set result to the number of consecutive reading pairs (same device, ordered by ts) where battery increased by more than 5 (an int).
answer:
d = readings.sort_values(['device_id', 'ts']).copy()
d['prev'] = d.groupby('device_id')['battery'].shift()
result = int(((d['battery'] - d['prev']) > 5).sum())

title: Daily max per device 1
task: Set result to a Series of daily max value for device 1 (resample 'D'), rounded to 3 decimals, sorted by day.

title: Median value per kind
task: Set result to a Series of median value per device kind, rounded to 3 decimals.

title: Readings in first week
task: Set result to the number of readings with ts in the first 7 days (2025-06-01 to 2025-06-07 inclusive) (an int).

title: Percent of readings in range
task: Set result to the percentage of non-missing readings that are within [low, high] for their kind, rounded to 1 decimal.
answer:
m = readings.dropna(subset=['value']).merge(devices, on='device_id').merge(thresholds, on='kind')
in_range = (m['value'] >= m['low']) & (m['value'] <= m['high'])
result = round(float(in_range.mean() * 100), 1)

title: Status label
task: Set result to readings merged with device kind and thresholds, plus a column status: 'high' if value>high, 'low' if value<low, else 'ok' (missing → 'missing'); keep reading_id, status.
hint: np.select or nested np.where; handle NaN.
answer:
m = readings.merge(devices, on='device_id').merge(thresholds, on='kind')
conds = [m['value'].isna(), m['value'] > m['high'], m['value'] < m['low']]
m['status'] = np.select(conds, ['missing', 'high', 'low'], default='ok')
result = m[['reading_id', 'status']]

title: Uptime per device
task: Set result to a Series of reported reading count per device_id as a percentage of 504 expected hours (21 days × 24), rounded to 1 decimal.

title: Busiest reading hour
task: Set result to the hour-of-day (0-23) with the most readings (an int).

title: Readings after maintenance
context: For maintenance row 1, count that device's readings after the maintenance ts.
task: Set result to the number of readings for the device in maintenance row 1 (iloc[0]) with ts after that maintenance ts (an int).
hint: get device_id and ts from maintenance.iloc[0].
answer:
m0 = maintenance.iloc[0]
result = int(((readings['device_id'] == m0['device_id']) & (readings['ts'] > m0['ts'])).sum())

title: Fill missing with device mean
task: Set result to readings with value missing values filled by that device's mean value; keep reading_id, device_id, value.

title: Average value by day-of-week
task: Set result to a Series of mean value per weekday name, ordered Mon..Sun, rounded to 3 decimals.

title: Std value per site
task: Set result to a Series of std (ddof=1) of value per site, rounded to 3 decimals, sorted descending.

title: Duplicate timestamps per device
context: A device shouldn't report twice in the same hour.
task: Set result to the number of (device_id, ts) pairs that occur more than once (an int).
hint: duplicated(subset=[...], keep=False) then count unique pairs, or groupby size>1.

title: Deviation from device mean
context: Center each reading on its device.
task: Set result to the number of readings whose value is more than 10 above its device's mean value (an int; ignore missing).
answer:
r = readings.dropna(subset=['value']).copy()
mean = r.groupby('device_id')['value'].transform('mean')
result = int((r['value'] - mean > 10).sum())
